params.name: aField
params.description: Field for which to set the storage location. Must be an actual field reference (e.g. [Table]FieldName) of type Text, BLOB, or Picture -- the doc's own Type column names the field's data type, not the shape of a value that can be passed here; a same-typed variable or literal is rejected by the compiler ("The function expects a field not a variable or constant.").

constraints: The setting only takes effect when the current record is saved to disk; if the record is canceled, the command has no effect.
path can be a custom pathname (relative to the data file, or absolute, in system syntax) or one of the documented numeric constants.
